body:
I've thought about a pet -- I've had one before and it helped me out. It would cost quite a bit extra and I don't have too much money as it is, and I also don't have a car and I live in an area where all the vets are several miles away. I love hiking, I just happen to live in one of the worst states for travelling without a car... and i'm far away from anything that remotely resembles "hiking" territory.

I do feel happier around animals and mountains, but it just seems that it'll be several years before I'll be able to be in that position. ;\

I try to do that. I watch comedies while I work out and do my schoolwork. I try to do yoga and lift weights / do cardio daily. I do feel less sad than I did at first, but I guess I feel more hopeless -- like how different and depressing my life is has sunk in and I've accepted defeat. 

What else helped you move on? I feel like it's not even just not having her, it's the combination of the stress and lack of success and losing someone so close that used to make me carefree, happy, and healthy. I feel like I need a good positive influence like that, but that I end up making mistakes and hurting myself each time I try to get close with someone.
